Bring truth to action with a unified platform, deeply integrated
Axonius is purpose-built to enable total visibility and sharp actionability across the full lifecycle of every technology asset.
One platform built to sit above the stack – not replace it.
Every asset class, one model
Devices, identities, SaaS, software, cloud, IoT, OT – every asset type enters one unified fabric regardless of where it lives.
Deep integrations with every tool
The broadest integration ecosystem in cybersecurity – not just fetching data, but pushing fixes, enriching systems, and enforcing policy.
Built for enterprise complexity
From thousands to millions of assets across distributed environments, M&A integrations, and hybrid stacks – the model holds.
